scenario_meta.world_name: Underground Black Market Auction Night 100-Agent Interaction Test
scenario_meta.description: A sealed underground black market auction night with buyers, sellers, bodyguards, appraisers, undercover agents, creditors, intelligence brokers, and auctioneers. The room is tense but controlled: bidding, bargaining, clue exchange, debt pressure, item appraisal, warnings, and escape coordination can escalate into light non-graphic control actions.
scenario_meta.simulation_objective: Run a 100-agent black-market auction interaction simulation that stresses complex relationship adjustment, fair and unfair trades, tension, debt pressure, undercover suspicion, ordinary JSON actions first, a single generic model-selected CinematicInteraction route for body actions, and image generation for rare lots, forged documents, and mystery boxes.
